name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS)
description: Turns HAGS on or off. HAGS can lower latency on recent NVIDIA/AMD GPUs with current drivers, but the effect varies by hardware and game and can be neutral or slightly negative. Defaults to the recommendation for your GPU; you choose the direction. Needs a reboot.
warning: HAGS is not a guaranteed win. Benchmark before and after; if FPS or frametimes get worse, toggle it back. Requires a reboot to take effect.
